blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When a language model answers, we can usually only estimate why. We build a transformer in which every step is a Born measurement - attention $|\langle q|k\rangle|^4$ normalised over each row, a measured product in place of the feed-forward nonlinearity, and a Born readout. With its denominators held at their values for the input, each class probability is a polynomial in the word amplitudes, so its integrated-gradient evidence is computed by a finite quadrature with no quadrature error: the words' contributions sum to the class probability above its no-information share, to $10^{-11}$ or better. On e-SNLI natural language inference, with about 98k parameters outside the embedding, the model reaches $76.98 \pm 0.17$% test accuracy, level with a softmax transformer of the same size ($76.62 \pm 0.36$%). Deleting the word its evidence ranks first changes the answer in 45% of test pairs, out of the 53% any single deletion can change, against 32% for the softmax model explained the same way and 40% by its attention x gradient. Attention can look more like the words annotators highlighted, yet accounts for the answer less well: deleting the word it ranks first changes the Born Transformer's answer in 32% of pairs. The same weights compile exactly to optoelectronic optics and to qubits, and a coherent attention layer becomes one circuit equal to the model (852 CNOTs on 23 qubits). On IBM's ibm_kingston, reading only the attention overlaps by Hadamard tests, the device gave the model's answers on two short test pairs and kept or changed them under deletion as the model does; the evidence itself did not yet survive the device, and we work out the shots and calibration that measuring it on hardware would need.
blocks.zh: 当一个语言模型回答时,我们通常只能估计原因. 我们建造一个变压器,其中每个步骤都是天生的测量——注意每行正常的$|\langle q|k\rangle 4$,一个测量的产品代替饲料前向的非线性,以及天生的读数。 其分母为输入值,每个类概率都是振幅词中的一种多元性,所以其综合渐变的证据是由一个没有四分法的有限四分法计算出来的:词对类概率的贡献总和高于其无信息份额,达到10^{-11}美元或更高. 在e-SNLI自然语言推论中,嵌入体外有约98k参数,该模型达到76.98\pm 0.17 %测试精度,水平与大小相同的软马克斯变压器(76.62\pm 0.36 %). 删除该词时,其证据排位会首先改变45%的测试对的答案,在53%的任何单一删除都可以改变,而软马克斯模型的32%的答案是相同的,40%的答案是注意x梯度。 注意可以看起来更像强调的注释者,然而说明答案不太好:删除它排列的词首先会改变"天生变形器"在32%的对中给出的答案. 同样的权重完全编译为光电子光学和qubit,一个连贯的注意力层成为一个与模型等效的电路(23qubit上的852 CNOTs). 在IBM的ibm_kingston上,只读到哈达默德测试的注意力重叠,设备在两个短测试对上给出了模型的答案,并像模型一样将其保留或修改在删除中;证据本身还没有在设备中存活下来,我们研究出在硬件上测量它所需要的镜头和校准.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

为什么一个语言模型给出它给出的答案通常只能被估计. 对神经网络的解释大多在培训后计算,并大致了解模型所做的,以及
对于语言模型,最显眼的数量,注意重量,不需要解释输出[1,2]. 一种基于错误原因的正确模型 从它的准确性来看
和正确者一样

blocks.en:
In earlier work, Seeing Why [ 3 ] , a picture classifier built from a Born readout gave evidence maps
that need no approximation, and that could be measured on the hardware that classifies. Pictures, however, are read
pixel by pixel; in a sentence, words matter through each other. Here we ask whether the same can be had for a model
that relates words: a transformer.

这与单词有关:变压器。

blocks.en:
Attention needs two things: an overlap between a query and a key, and a weighted sum. Both are native to light and to
qubits: an overlap is an interference, a weighted sum a coherent combination. What is not native is the softmax. We
replace every nonlinearity of a transformer—softmax, LayerNorm, ReLU—by one operation, a Born measurement, the
rule Born gave a century ago [ 4 ] . The model is then a ratio of polynomials in the word amplitudes, and its
evidence follows exactly from integrated gradients [ 5 ] with the denominators held.
blocks.zh:
注意需要两件事:一个查询和一个密钥的重叠,和一个加权总和. 两者都是原生的光线
qubits:一个重叠是干扰,一个加权和是一个连贯的组合. 不是本地人就是软体人 我们
将变压器的每一个非线性——软电压、电路、ReLU——替换为一次操作、天生测量、
规则 出生在一个世纪前[4]。 该模型在振幅词中是多名数的比值,以及它的
证据完全来自综合梯度[5]和分母。

blocks.en:
Because the evidence is exact and part of the model, the model can be checked as well as scored: we report, for every
model, accuracy beside the completeness of its evidence, a deletion test and agreement with human highlights.
blocks.zh:
由于证据准确,是模型的一部分,可以检查模型和得分:我们报告,每个
模型,除了其证据的完整性外,准确性,删除测试和与人类亮点一致.

blocks.en:
The model is interpretable by design: its explanation is part of how it is built, not an estimate added after
training, and the accuracy it gives up for that is the cost of the design. Where the exactness comes from should be
said plainly. It comes from the model being a polynomial once its
denominators are held, and a classical polynomial network without any measurement constraint has it as well
(Section 3 ). What the Born rule adds is that this polynomial is what a physical measurement computes:
the same exact evidence then comes with a model that light and qubits can run, and the questions become physical
ones—which measurements, how many shots, what loss of visibility the evidence tolerates.

blocks.en:
Light and qubits then pull the design in two directions. On light a measurement is cheap—a detector—and a field can be split into copies,
but classical fields cannot hold the copies together in a tensor product; on qubits they can, but every measurement costs shots. So we build
the model twice from the same idea: the Born Transformer , which measures inside every block and suits light,
and a coherent attention layer , which measures only at the end and suits qubits. Both keep exact evidence, and
the attention of the first, read by small circuits, runs on a quantum computer today.

A transformer has three kinds of nonlinearity: the softmax of attention, LayerNorm and the ReLU of the feed-forward
layer. None of them is something light or qubits do. A Born measurement is: it squares the modulus of an amplitude.
We build every step from that.

blocks.en: 3 Natural language inference with exact evidence
blocks.zh: 3 准确证据的自然语言推论

blocks.en: 3.1 The task: does one sentence follow from another?
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务:一句从另一句接过来吗?

blocks.en:
Natural language inference asks whether a hypothesis follows from a premise. Given “A woman working long hours”,
the hypothesis “A woman is working” follows ( entailment ), “A woman is sleeping” cannot be true at the same
time ( contradiction ), and “A woman is working in a factory” may or may not be ( neutral ;
Fig. 3 ). The answer is in neither sentence alone but in how the two relate, which is what attention is
for. SNLI [ 9 ] collected such pairs about image captions; e-SNLI [ 10 ] added, for
every pair, the words an annotator highlighted as the reason and a sentence explaining it. Those highlights are what
makes the data useful here: they are an outside account of which words decide the answer, against which a model’s
evidence can be checked.

时间(矛盾),以及“妇女在工厂工作”可能(中立);
答案不单在于句子,而在于两者的关系,这就是人们所关注的。

blocks.en:
e-SNLI has 549,367 training, 9,842 dev and 9,824 test pairs, about a third per label; a pair has 23 tokens at the
median (premise, separator, hypothesis; vocabulary 22,319 words seen three times or more), and annotators highlight
about one word in three. A bag of words with logistic
regression reaches at most 65.7 % (one bag per sentence; the hypothesis alone gives 64.8 %, the known bias of
SNLI), so a model must relate the two sentences to do better. We compare three models of the same size (98–100k parameters
outside a 1.43M embedding), each with two blocks, two heads and a pooled readout: the Born Transformer; a softmax
transformer (real d = 64 d=64 , softmax attention, GELU feed-forward of width 256, LayerNorm, a linear head); and
Poly-sim-born, a real-valued polynomial transformer with normalised
attention ( q ⋅ k ) 2 / ∑ (q\cdot k)^{2}/\sum and a bilinear feed-forward but no constraint from measurements (a
simulation reference, not a hardware model). All were trained for 20 epochs on sentences of up to 64 tokens in batches of 64 with Adam [ 11 ] , learning
rate 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} (chosen on the dev split, 9,842 pairs, for the Born and softmax models), cosine decay, word dropout 0.1, three
seeds; the softmax model’s evidence is the same integrated gradients (256 nodes), which is not exact for it.
Evidence is judged three ways, each on the predicted class: the gap , how far the word evidence is from summing
to the explained score; deletion , deleting the top 1–5 words by evidence and recording the mean drop of the
answer’s probability (AOPC) and how often the answer changes (flip@ k k ), against a random order of deletion; and agreement , the share of the evidence’s top k k words that annotators highlighted, with k k the number of
highlighted words in the pair (chance 0.354). Deleting a word sets its amplitude to zero in the Born models and removes
the token from attention and pooling in the others, in place, so positions do not shift. The highlights are the
union over the test split’s three annotators, and every metric uses the same 1,000 test pairs.

Poly-sim-born, the polynomial model without the measurement

lowest in 11 % instead of 2 %, and agreement with the annotators falls from 0.53 to 0.46. With softmax attention

chance at the low end. The quality of the evidence goes with the whole model being one polynomial, not with one
part of it.

Every fixed matrix is divided by its largest singular value, so that it is a
contraction—a block of a unitary on twice the modes, built from beam splitters and attenuators. Every word field is
scaled to norm at most one. Splitting a state into its query, key, value and residual copies, fanning a key out to
the slots it meets, and combining the residual are passive beam splitters, each losing a known share of the light.
None of this changes the answer: the attention weights ( 2 ) and the readout ( 4 ) are
ratios and do not see a common scale, and the only place where scale matters, the measured
feed-forward ( 3 ), is followed by a classical gain on measured numbers that puts the lost scale back before
the modulator writes W 3 ​ r W_{3}r . The build is optoelectronic, not passive throughout: between its interferometers
are detectors, a classical gain and fresh modulators. The compiled pass equals the trained model to 2 × 10 − 15 2\times 10^{-15} (the largest difference on 512 test pairs); what compiling
costs is light, not accuracy (Fig. 5 ). With shot noise at every detector and finite modulator

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en:
Quantum self-attention networks measure query and key circuits and form the weights
classically: Gaussian-projected attention for text classification [ 16 ] , query–key similarity of mixed
states [ 17 ] ; quantum vision transformers add orthogonal layers and a compound-matrix attention computed
on the quantum side, run on superconducting hardware up to six qubits [ 18 ] ; a survey sorts the field into circuit-based and
quantum-linear-algebra families [ 19 ] . Like the Born Transformer’s Hadamard tests, the self-attention
networks measure between the quantum and the classical steps. Quixer prepares a superposition of token unitaries by a linear combination of
unitaries and applies a quantum singular value transform [ 20 ] , closest in spirit to our coherent
layer; quantum linear algebra can block-encode every part of a transformer for fault-tolerant machines [ 21 , 15 ] . A recent theoretical construction realises single-head softmax attention
with Born-rule measurements, for inputs and outputs on the probability simplex: scores read by Hadamard tests on
block-encoded projections, a cos 2 \cos^{2} readout normalised over each row that equals the softmax on the interior of the
simplex, one measure-and-reload step per attention score—hybrid, as our device runs are—and a coherent variant
that is ε \varepsilon -approximate by quantum singular value transformation in the limit of infinite depth, with a
no-go result for an exact finite-depth one with affinely encoded scores [ 22 ] . It is complementary to ours: it realises the softmax itself, as a
circuit-level construction, where here the Born rule replaces the softmax in a model that is trained, explained and
run.

经典: Gaussian 预测的文本分类注意 [16], 查询 - 混合键的相似性
表示 [17]; 量子视变压器增加正交层和计算出的化合物-矩阵注意力

blocks.en:
QLens describes a classical transformer’s layers as unitaries on a state
whose Born-rule measurement gives the output distribution, as a lens for interpreting it [ 23 ] . A fully coherent quantum transformer block has been read through the mutual
information, entanglement and fidelity of its states [ 24 ] ; compositional models of text
trained classically and run on trapped ions are interpretable by construction [ 25 ] , the same
choice of training classically as ours; compositional circuits have also been applied to natural language
inference [ 26 ] , and compositional models of meaning were run on IBM hardware [ 27 ] . Quantum-inspired language models use complex word embeddings whose phases encode position [ 28 ] , as our word fields do. Here the explanation is a decomposition of the answer itself into the words, exact,
and checked against people.
blocks.zh:
QLens 将古典变压器的层称为状态上的单位
其Born-rule测量给出了输出分布,作为解释它的透镜[23]. 一个完全一致的量子变压器块已经通过相互读取
信息、其状态的缠绕和忠诚[24];文本的构成模式

推论[26],和意的构成模型在IBM硬件上运行[27]. 量子启发语言模型使用复杂的词嵌入,其阶段编码位置[28],就像我们的词域一样. 这里的解释是将答案本身分解为词,准确的,

blocks.en:
Our optics follow coherent nanophotonic meshes for neural networks [ 29 ] and electro-optic activations that tap and re-modulate light [ 30 ] ,
as our measured feed-forward does. Transformer operations have run on an optical matrix–vector
multiplier [ 31 ] , and photonic accelerators target attention: its products of two dynamic
operands [ 32 ] and the cost of converting signals between light and electronics [ 33 ] . The photonic transformer chip of Tian et al. [ 34 ] replaces every multiplication of attention with an optical interference read by balanced detection and drops the
softmax, and runs a vision transformer on a fabricated chip (94 % on 100 MNIST test digits). We share its two
observations—interference gives Re ⁡ ( a ​ b ∗ ) \mathrm{Re}(ab^{*}) , and attention can work without a softmax—reached there from
device physics and here from the Born rule; that work has a fabricated chip, while our optics are simulated.

blocks.en:
Bilinear feed-forward layers, the elementwise product of two linear
images, make a network’s weights readable by eigendecomposition [ 35 ] ; our measured feed-forward
is of that form, read here as an interference. Polynomial attention has been used for speed [ 6 ] .

图像, 使一个网络的权重可以读取 eigendecomposition [35]; 我们测量到的种子前进
是这种形式的,在这里读作干扰。 Polynomial 注意力被用于速度 [6].

blocks.en:
Whether attention weights explain a model is debated [ 1 , 2 ] ; our evidence is not the attention weights but an exact decomposition
of the answer. Relevance propagation through transformers conserves relevance by its rules [ 36 , 37 ] ; here conservation is a property of integrated gradients on a model
that is a polynomial once its denominators are held, and a finite quadrature computes it. Our deletion test is the form of the faithfulness metrics of rationale benchmarks such as
ERASER [ 38 ] , on the e-SNLI highlights [ 10 ] .

ERASER [38],在e-SNLI亮点上 [10].

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en:
A transformer whose every nonlinearity is a Born measurement answers natural language inference as well as a softmax
transformer of its size and explains each answer exactly, word by word—exact because the model is a polynomial
once its denominators are held, physical because that polynomial is what a measurement computes—in a way that can
be checked: against the
answer it accounts for, by deleting words, and against what people highlighted; its attention weights, as close to
what people highlighted, account for the answer less well. One set of weights compiles exactly to
light and to qubits; without measurements inside, attention becomes one circuit equal to the model. On a quantum
computer today the answer survives, and deleting the word the evidence ranks first changes it as the model says it
should; measuring the evidence itself there needs row calibrations within a few per cent, and the coherent layer a
higher pass rate. Keeping the polynomial’s degree under control through attention and several layers is what makes the model
interpretable by design. We hope the evidence, and not accuracy alone, becomes part of how such models are judged.

检查:对照
